sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Only obtainable as a reward from the "EXFIL Brothers" program.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Document case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 16 inventory slots in a 4x4 grid and only takes up 2 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Currency
- Keys & Keycards
- Posters
- Maps
- Info items
- Keycard holder case
- DesmondPilak CD
- Physical Bitcoin
- Veritas guitar pick
